name: The Happy Cannabis Company  Loves Park
how_menu_reached: Retailer /shop pages load the Jane headless embed (api.iheartjane.com/v2/headless/embed.js); no iframe
branch_selection: Client-side store picker modal (Rockford rec, Rockford med, Loves Park rec). Default is Rockford rec: #jane-store-id data-store-id=1410. Selecting Loves Park gives data-store-id=3769. URL does not change.

data_loading.mechanism: Jane dmerch search (backend/providers/jane.py handles it once provider_store_id is known)

blockers: thehappycannaco.com returns HTTP 403 to headless Playwright Chrome; loads in an ordinary browser. Recorded as a block, not evaded (CLAUDE.md).

pipeline_result.sample: no saved endpoint, nothing to sample

why_it_fails: resolution/website discovery: fallback search returned NO_LEAD. Stored evidence shows html.duckduckgo.com answers HTTP 202 with a bot challenge and www.bing.com/search answers 200 with unrelated Microsoft pages for the quoted-address query, so no candidate website is ever found even though the brand site exists. Even with the site, static HTML has no numeric Jane store id (loader-script embed); the id only appears in rendered DOM after the right store is picked, and the default is the wrong branch (Rockford). Headless access is also 403.
fix_idea: Replace the fallback search with a working source (e.g. the OpenRouter web plugin the verifier already uses, or a brand-level locator) and treat a results page where nothing names the store as a search failure, not 'no lead'. Jane resolver: read #jane-store-id / dmerch store_id from the rendered page and drive the store picker to the registry branch. Loves Park rec = 3769.
